About Shokz
At Shokz, we're redefining the listening experience through innovative open-ear audio technology. As our business continues to grow globally, we're looking for passionate Marketing Specialists to strengthen our brand presence and build meaningful connections with consumers across North America. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves sports, enjoys working with people, and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

This posting covers the roles listed below. You only need to apply once, and our recruiting team will match you with the role that best fits your experience and interests. You may be considered for one of the following positions:

[1. User Research Specialist]
What You'll Do
Plan and execute qualitative and quantitative consumer research projects that support marketing strategy, brand initiatives, and business decision-making across North America.
Recruit participants for consumer and market research while building scalable, cost-effective recruitment channels and local research resources.
Conduct agile field research to validate emerging consumer needs, sports scenarios, and market opportunities through interviews, observations, intercepts, and other in-market research methods.
Identify localized consumer behaviors, cultural insights, and market trends to help the business better understand North American consumers.
Collaborate closely with the Global Consumer Insights team in China throughout the research process, including research design, participant recruitment, fieldwork, insight generation, and reporting.
Respond quickly to ad hoc research requests from regional teams and deliver actionable insights within fast-moving business timelines.
Support research activities during sporting events, trade shows, community activations, and other offline marketing initiatives across North America.
Continuously expand local research resources by developing relationships with agencies, communities, organizations, and alternative participant recruitment channels to improve research quality while optimizing costs.

What We're Looking For
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above.
1–3 years of experience in User Research, Consumer Insights, UX Research, or Market Research.
Experience working in multinational companies or research agencies serving global brands.
Experience recruiting research participants and coordinating field research activities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across diverse communities.
Fluent in English.

[2. Influencer & Community Marketing]
What You'll Do
Develop and execute influencer and community marketing initiatives across North America.
Identify and build relationships with influencers, creators, athletes, coaches, and sports communities.
Manage influencer collaborations, including outreach, campaign execution, content coordination, and performance tracking.
Build and grow local communities around key sports and lifestyle categories, such as running, fitness, cycling, hiking, and skiing.
Plan and support community activations, sporting events, expos, and other local marketing initiatives.
Identify and develop partnerships with sports clubs, communities, events, and local organizations.
Monitor local social media and consumer trends to identify new influencers, communities, and marketing opportunities.
Work closely with global marketing teams to localize strategies for the North American market.
Continuously expand Shokz's local influencer, community, and marketing resources.

What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree or above.
1–3 years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Community Marketing, Sports Marketing, Social Media Marketing, or related fields.
Experience working with influencers, creators, athletes, or communities.
Strong communication, relationship-building, and project management skills.
Fluent in English.
Passion for sports, fitness, or outdoor activities.

[3. Sports Event Marketing]
What You'll Do
Event Planning & Execution: Organize and execute event marketing activities in targeted U.S. cities, including running clubs, sports communities, and marathon events.
Brand Integration: Develop strategies to effectively integrate the brand into events, ensuring maximum visibility and engagement with potential customers.
User Engagement: Engage with target audiences at events to enhance brand awareness, promote product features, and collect user feedback.
Partnership Development: Collaborate with local sports organizations, influencers, and event coordinators to build strong partnerships and expand brand presence.
Sales Support: Utilize event opportunities to support sales efforts, including lead generation, follow-up, and conversion tracking.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor and report on the success of marketing events, including ROI, brand reach, and customer engagement.

What We're Looking For
Personality Traits: Highly outgoing, passionate, and enthusiastic with a strong sales orientation. Proven ability to drive results through interpersonal communication.
Brand Passion: A genuine love for the Shokz brand and its products, with the ability to effectively represent and promote the brand.
Love for Sports: Passionate about sports and fitness, with a personal commitment to an active lifestyle. Previous experience in sports industry marketing (equipment, event sponsorships) like Nike, Adidas, Asics or community management (specifically referring to running or cycling communities) is a plus.
Travel Requirements: Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the U.S. for event execution.
Language Skills: Proficiency in English is required.

The Sales Rep will be responsible for helping the sales team build new targeted accounts, sell our OpenHear(soon to launch) prescription hearing aids with specific revenue and profitability targets in the B2B field, target the medical device field, and provide coaching on building up all aspects of the B2B sales system, including product updates, price system, distributors management, etc.
Shokz is planning to sign a 12-month contract with the Sales Rep. The relationship will be further evaluated before the resigning of the contract. We offer a high base salary as well as a bonus (based on sales performance). Pay will be discussed after the interview.
Qualifications
At least 3 years working experience with Sonova/Demant/GN Group/WS Audiology/Starkey hearing aids product line is necessary
Experience in B2B distributors management: HearUSA, Miracle-Ear, or Amplifon.
Experience in hearing aids resellers, independent hearing center management.
Experience working with major US hearing aid insurance providers , such as Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, VA.
Able to identify potential clients and customer groups in the local and national markets with knowledge of competitor operations, strengths and strategies
Ability to develop sales strategies and proposals by using client and company knowledge to evaluate potential projects and accounts
Ability to make frequent contact with potential clients, established clients and local/national business leaders to promote the business systems and its services
Excellent Communication Skills Required

Our Ideal Candidate
Creates and maintains effective partner relationships with Shokz partner principles nationally
Supports and provides guidance in B2B sales system building on both the distributor level and reseller level
Willingness to and capable of making appointments with key person of potential partners in hearing aids field.

Why work for us
Shokz INC is a leading global bone conduction technology company with offices in Austin, Texas, USA. We are a pioneer and key player in the bone conduction sports headphone industry, holding over 2,000 bone conduction-related patents worldwide and boasting the world's largest sales volume of bone conduction headphones.

OpenHear Hearing Aids are our new flagship product line built on the latest bone conduction technology. Featuring unique bone conduction technology and breakthrough comfort, they address the drawbacks of existing hearing aids in terms of appearance and ease of use. They are expected to capture greater market opportunities among those with conductive, mixed, and mild to moderate sensorineural hearing loss.
